knowledge_answers.rationale: The wicket-keeper must remain wholly behind the striker's wicket until one of the listed release events.
Umpires must be satisfied about an in-match injury affecting running or another wholly acceptable reason; the runner must be a member of the batting side and meet the additional restrictions.
The threshold depends on scheduled duration; for a three- or four-day match it is at least 150 runs, so exactly 150 qualifies.
Deliberate fielder damage is handled as unfair play; restoration or repair of the pitch remains under umpire control; a private repair attempt does not cancel the warning or penalty procedure.
